result.title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
result.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

AI.brief_summary: FineSplat 是面向细粒度图像 patch 的 feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架：为控制高分辨率 token 上的注意力开销，采用视角分组与 3D 空间分组两种局部性聚合策略，并以重建误差作为反馈信号细化几何与外观。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视角局部性 + 提升到 3D 空间重连不相邻 token」的分组聚合，以及「用渲染重建误差做显式反馈、突破一次前向预测」的迭代细化，可能为 LVR 中细粒度视觉证据的聚合与筛选、latent 状态的迭代更新提供可核查的方法线索，但与多模态推理本身距离较远。
